column1: # This is the external command surface of the enabled shell, shared services,
# and 37 selected Omarchy command implementations. Omarchy-prefixed commands
awk|gawk|required-existing|Selected audio, battery, display, network and system-stat helpers.
bash|bash|required-existing|Quickshell process wrappers and selected helper implementations.
busctl|systemd|required-existing|Notifications and UPower property queries over D-Bus.
cat|coreutils|required-existing|Selected battery and display helpers plus plugin scanning.
date|coreutils|required-existing|Display helper cache timing and Hyprland scale audit records.
grep|grep|required-existing|Battery, display, IPC and input parsing.
head|coreutils|required-existing|Battery, display and Wayland socket selection.
hyprctl|hyprland|required-existing|Monitor, input, scaling, focus and compositor state.
ip|iproute2|required-existing|Enabled network status and route discovery.
iw|iw|required-existing|Built-in Wi-Fi band and radio detail actions.
jq|jq|required-shell|Enabled OSD, display and notification JSON handling.
pgrep|procps-ng|required-existing|Foot text-size notification and terminal reload probes.
printf|bash|required-existing|Shell built-in used by selected helpers and QML command strings.
rm|coreutils|required-existing|Temporary network and optional display cache cleanup.
sed|sed|required-existing|Text-size editing and selected status parsing.
timeout|coreutils|required-existing|Bounds audio, Bluetooth and shell IPC operations.
upower|upower|required-shell|Enabled battery query and power panel details.
uwsm-app|uwsm|required-existing|Application scopes without enabling a UWSM session.
asdcontrol|asdcontrol|inactive-optional|Apple external-display helper only; never selected for the internal DSI panel and unavailable in the initial layer.
ddcutil|ddcutil|inactive-optional|External DDC/CI display helper only; never selected for the internal DSI panel.
sudo|sudo|inactive-optional|Apple external-display helper only; no enabled internal-panel path invokes it.
